No temple, no stone ruin, no waterfall, no jungle, no magic, no franchise logo, no readable lettering, no HUD, no people or creatures. Create one opaque 16:9 background panorama, ideally1920x1080. Camera exactly level, side-on to a long indoor military station service corridor, viewing a wall parallel to the playable floor; restrained receding side corridors only. Architecture: wide steel bulkheads, rectangular wall panels, practical recessed conduits and fluorescent housings. Keep a flat horizontal rear wall/floor seam at76%of image height; the front quarter remains empty dark horizontal floor with no crates or props that would intrude into the duel. Central open field for two fighters. Behind them, an elevated distant service walkway runs horizontally at60%of image height, grounded in steel supports. On that walkway leave TWO plain dark rectangular recessed wall alcoves completely empty, one atx27%, one atx72%, fromy29%to60%; these alcoves will later receive independent animated observation-window and airlock modules. No characters baked into the background, no window silhouettes. On the center wall atx50%,y40% leave a small flat clear mounting panel for a separate warning sensor. Room is enclosed, grimy utilitarian USCM military base, human scale, dense believable construction but very legible clear fighting area. Do not draw foreground pillars or hanging cables; these are separate layers.
